verdict.rationale: The MI325X is a CDNA3 datacenter AI/HPC accelerator in an OAM module, supported by ROCm for AI and HPC workloads. Gaming upscaling and frame generation (DLSS/FSR) are a category error for this kind of product, and nothing in the evidence shows it ships any such capability.

support.subject: As a gamer, AI upscaling and frame generation are supported on this card — the DLSS or FSR generation is documented for this part, with broad game support
